Academic Programs

Which courses does EmbryoGenesis offer?

EmbryoGenesis offers the B.Sc. & M.Sc. Clinical Embryology with ITHS & Bahra University and the B.Sc., M.Sc., Ph.D. and PG Diploma in ART & Clinical Embryology with ITHS & Rayat Bahra University, along with hands-on lab training.

B.Sc. & M.Sc. Clinical Embryology with ITHS & Bahra University

Build a thriving career in reproductive sciences with advanced programs in Clinical Embryology. Learn from experts and access cutting-edge facilities.

  • BSc in Clinical Embryology · 4 Years
  • MSc in Clinical Embryology · 2 Years (4 Semesters)
  • Department of Clinical Embryology, Bahra University, Shimla Hills, Himachal Pradesh
View Course: B.Sc. & M.Sc. Clinical Embryology, Bahra UniversityApply Now

B.Sc. & M.Sc. ART & Clinical Embryology With ITHS & Rayat Bahra University

Master Assisted Reproductive Technology (ART) and Clinical Embryology with comprehensive academic and practical training at Rayat Bahra University.

  • B.Sc. · M.Sc. · Ph.D. · PG Diploma in ART & Clinical Embryology
  • 1 to 4 Years, depending on the programme
  • Institute of Translational Health Science, Rayat Bahra University, Mohali, Punjab
View Course: ART & Clinical Embryology, Rayat Bahra UniversityApply Now

Why Choose Embryogenesis?

At Embryogenesis, we know that understanding the root cause of fertility challenges is the first step toward successful treatment.
